text: さいごに　＊は　＊を　くりだし　＊は　＊で　おうせんした！

patterns.name: 〜ます stem (linking)
patterns.explanation: A verb cut short to the form that goes before ます joins two actions like 'and', in a written style. くりだし = 'sent out, and'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で after a thing says what was used to do the action. ＊で　おうせんした = 'fought back with ＊'.
